name: Alan Turing
bio: Fifteen in October 1927. As a young man he read von Neumann's book on the foundations of quantum mechanics. He founded the theory of computation and, late in life, returned to quantum mechanics, noting that continuous observation would seem to freeze a system's evolution.

silences.note: Turing's recorded remarks on quantum mechanics are few and late. Most of what he might say here is speculative, and is labelled so.

guest.whyInvited: The question of what can be computed turned out to be a question about physics.
